desc: Three cards at once on one computer (Goombella out; Koops, Flurrie and Yoshi joined: players 3 and 4 have Yoshi and Flurrie): 2P at the left, 3P in the middle, 4P at the right. 2P's Character: the strip with Yoshi and Flurrie dimmed (players 3 and 4 have them), right to Koops (free: Mario has him), who comes after a moment (Mario's partner, live); 4P's Controls (glyphs and actions, two columns). Shots: the three home cards, the strip, the pages, closed. 4:3 and Spanish menus (long words: nothing clipped)
